title: Dock doesn't show cpu, memory, networking or GPU data, crashes when clicking on item flyout view.

status.label: Needs Information
status.detail: CmdPal Dock 0.99.0 reportedly shows unknown CPU/memory/network/GPU values and crashes after interaction with a metric flyout.

next_action.label: Identify CmdPal Dock package
next_action.reason: Identify the Dock provider and reproduce the supplied sequence before assigning a component fix.

judgment.rationale: The report is concrete enough for a maintainer reproduction, but the failing Dock provider/package is not identified. The checked-in CmdPal extension tree contains Dock UI but no corresponding performance-provider implementation. Identify package ownership before choosing a code path; do not ask for logs already supplied.
judgment.recommended_action: Identify the Dock provider and reproduce the supplied sequence before assigning a component fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The likely PowerToys path remains uncertain; the proposed direction is provisional and paired with the specific evidence request.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Dock metric flyouts valid when performance data is unavailable
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The metric provider may return no data while the flyout assumes populated results; this remains a low-confidence hypothesis because the provider is not in the checked-in CmdPal tree.
plan: Identify the Dock extension/package and provider that supplies the reported metrics.
Handle pending or unavailable metrics without entering an invalid flyout state.
Test empty/pending metric data and closing the flyout after provider failure.
verification: Reproduce with the reported Dock package.
Verify unavailable metrics remain safe to open/click and CmdPal stays alive.

confidence.rationale: The UI symptom is clear, but no matching provider was found in the pinned extension source.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed metric/flyout sequence and for attaching the file. The checked-in CmdPal sources do not identify the CPU/GPU provider shown. Could you confirm the exact Dock/extension package and PowerToys version, and whether the crash still occurs on latest stable? Please do not reattach the existing file. This identifies which component owns the missing values and flyout crash.

actions.label: Reproduce locally
actions.note: The reported sequence is concrete enough for maintainer validation.

reproduce.title: Reproduce Dock metric and flyout failure
prerequisites: The same Dock/metric extension package used in the report.
setup: Enable the Dock and expose CPU, memory, network and GPU items.
steps: Open Dock and check whether each metric shows a value or “???”.
Click CPU and wait for its flyout.
Click within the flyout and observe whether it turns gray or opens the crash dialog.
reproduce.expected_result: Available metrics populate; unavailable data does not crash CmdPal when a flyout is opened or clicked.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Use the reporter-provided package identity to prepare the same CmdPal Dock configuration; do not infer a third-party package.
